skeleton.note: the T12_5_guard skeleton, joint list identical in name and order (gear.gd compares them); 100% on weapon_r

frame: weapon_r local: origin the grip's middle on its axis, +Y to the tip, +Z an edge, X the flat normal -- the axe's convention (52_weapon_bones), so the mount code is shared
dims_note: overall set to 0.90 m; the rest follows the painted proportions (blade/grip 4.82 on the sheet, 5.20 on the model, whose grip band ends at the collars). The dispatch's 5x and its 72 cm / 11-12 cm targets disagree (72/11.5 = 6.3x); 0.90 m overall gives a 68 cm blade and a 13 cm grip including both bronze collars. Blade thickness: Tripo made the edge-on line 2.3 cm; thinned x0.5 to 1.2 cm over the blade only (above the guard, blended over 1 cm).

mount.seat: the T12_5_guard mount (weapon_mount.json, 52_weapon_bones --roll 0): the channel is the hand's, not the weapon's

roll_withdrawn.why: the scene drax gated the sword through the scene's tree (53_weapon_gate): at roll 0 its edge sits exactly on the axe's, and -39 FAILS the edge row on both strikes (+0.71, +0.64). The -39 fit minimised |edge| over hold rows whose IDLE half was measured with the sword turned 65.74 deg about its blade -- Blender held weapon_r, which idle_guard does not key, at the file's first animation's pose (attack's first key), where glTF and Godot put it at rest. The roll corrected the instrument, not the sword. Found bone by bone: every joint's Blender pose matched the glTF-evaluated global to 0.00 deg except weapon_r, 65.74, in idle_guard only; walk_armed, which keys weapon_r, measured 0.6 deg off (the PCA's own 0.57).
roll_withdrawn.fix: w5_measure.py bind() resets every pose bone to rest before binding a clip

mount.body: export/nb-body_sword.glb: the T12_5_guard body, BYTE-IDENTICAL (roll 0 is the T12_5 mount; w6_roll.py --roll 0 copies it, sha c7171dc20fba)

record_T12_5.frame: RightHand local (the frame the skin's inverse bind maps into), glTF units

guard_gate.predicate: sword HOLD (the T12 gate adapted): blade tilt 30-60 deg from vertical, blade forward AND outboard, tip outboard of the fist, |edge heading| <= 45 deg; the frame from the sword's own skinned geometry (grip = weapon_r's joint, blade = to the farthest vertex, edge = the blade's widest spread)
guard_gate.instrument: w5_measure.py, FIXED 2026-09-30 (un-keyed channels at rest): its idle edge now agrees with the glTF-evaluated edge to 0.6 deg on every row. The walk's verdict still belongs to the scene's tree (the edge row on the strikes too)

walk.caveat: NOT knight.gd's tree (no armed-speed split): tilt exceeds 60 deg on 7 of 16 frames here; the T12 gate measured the axe's walk at tilt 35 through the scene's tree. The walk's verdict belongs to guard_accept.gd in the scene.

guard_gate.pen_instrument: six-ray parity against the posed body with grip_R = 1; the grip's own length and anything within 2 cm of a RightHand-weighted vertex excluded (the fist)
